Unlike standard coolers, these feature durable polyester exteriors and leakproof liners that keep contents cold for hours. Add your logo via screen printing or embroidery for a polished look that reflects quality. Perfect for marketing directors seeking upscale giveaways or HR directors planning employee appreciation packages.
